name: Ringlet
source:
Main character spends last school year with cheerful classmates and childhood friends. There are things that change during this June month, there are some that remain the same. Encounter with unusual girl brings unusual love bloom.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与开朗的同学和青梅竹马一起度过学生时代的最后一年。在这个六月，有些事正在改变，也有些事始终如故。与一名不同寻常的少女相遇后，一段非同寻常的爱情悄然绽放。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
